## What this case checks

Expose helpers that preserve wrapped geographic longitudes instead of normalizing them back into the usual [-180, 180] interval.

## Risk types covered

- `longitude_not_normalized`
- `wrapped_coordinate_retention`

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `Point` |

## Notes

This fixture stores a valid EPSG:4326 point using a wrapped longitude of `190°`.
It is useful for helpers that should normalize geographic longitude values back
into the conventional `[-180, 180]` range.

## Required capabilities

- `load`
- `geometry-validation`
- `coordinate-normalization`
